spec.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob1 AS event, sum(_sample_interval) AS events FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('js_error', 'engine_panic', 'stuck_decision', 'chunk_reload', 'wasm_not_initialized') GROUP BY t, event ORDER BY t

spec.description: Daily error/failure events. Excludes p2p_disconnect (see Multiplayer).
spec.title: Problems per day (by type)

spec.query: SELECT if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'engine_panic') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start'), 2), 0) AS n FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('engine_panic', 'game_start')

spec.description: engine_panic events per 100 game_start events in range.
spec.title: Engine panics / 100 games

spec.query: SELECT if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'js_error') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start'), 2), 0) AS n FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('js_error', 'session_start')

spec.description: js_error events per 100 session_start events in range (client caps js_error at 10/session).
spec.title: JS errors / 100 sessions

spec.query: SELECT if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'stuck_decision') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start'), 2), 0) AS n FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('stuck_decision', 'game_start')

spec.description: stuck_decision episodes per 100 game_start events in range.
spec.title: Stuck decisions / 100 games

spec.query: SELECT if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_end') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start'), 1), 0) AS n FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('game_end', 'game_start')

spec.description: game_end / game_start in range. Low values mean abandoned or crashed games.
spec.title: Game completion

spec.query: SELECT if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'chunk_reload') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start'), 2), 0) AS n FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('chunk_reload', 'session_start')

spec.description: chunk_reload events per 100 session_start events in range (stale-bundle reloads after a deploy).
spec.title: Chunk reloads / 100 sessions

spec.query: SELECT timestamp, blob1 AS event, blob2 AS version, blob4 AS platform, blob5 AS kind, blob6 AS message, if(blob1 = 'js_error', blob7, '') AS top_frame, if(blob1 = 'js_error', blob8, if(double1 = 1, 'fatal', 'recovered')) AS source, if(blob1 = 'js_error', blob9, blob7) AS route_or_mode FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('js_error', 'engine_panic') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

spec.description: Latest js_error + engine_panic rows. top_frame covers V8 (`at fn (…)`) and Firefox/Safari (`fn@…`) stacks; clients before v0.106 report it for Chrome/Edge/desktop only. source is the JS listener or the panic's fatal/recovered outcome.
spec.title: Recent errors

spec.query: SELECT blob1 AS event, blob5 AS kind, blob6 AS message, if(blob1 = 'js_error', blob7, '') AS top_frame, sum(_sample_interval) AS occurrences, count(DISTINCT blob3) AS builds, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, argMax(blob2, timestamp) AS latest_version FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('js_error', 'engine_panic') GROUP BY event, kind, message, top_frame ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 50

spec.description: js_error + engine_panic grouped across builds. kind = JS error name or panic reason; last_seen/latest_version show whether a bug is still live.
spec.title: Error signatures

spec.query: SELECT blob7 AS game_mode, blob6 AS winner_kind, blob5 AS result, sum(_sample_interval) AS games, round(avg(double1), 1) AS avg_turns FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'game_end' GROUP BY game_mode, winner_kind, result ORDER BY games DESC

spec.title: Game outcomes (mode x winner_kind, avg turns)

spec.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob4 AS platform, sum(_sample_interval) AS sessions FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'session_start' GROUP BY t, platform ORDER BY t

spec.description: session_start per day; platform is 'web' or 'tauri' (desktop).
spec.title: Sessions per day (by platform)

spec.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob5 AS game_mode, sum(_sample_interval) AS games FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'game_start' GROUP BY t, game_mode ORDER BY t

SELECT if(blob1 = 'game_start', blob5, blob7) AS mode, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') AS starts, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_end') AS ends, if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_end') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start'), 1), 0) AS completion_pct FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('game_start', 'game_end') GROUP BY mode ORDER BY starts DESC

spec.description: game_start vs game_end per mode, with completion %.
spec.title: Game completion (by mode)

spec.query: SELECT blob5 AS oracle_id, blob7 AS name, sum(_sample_interval) AS reports, round(avg(double2), 1) AS avg_supported, round(avg(double3), 1) AS avg_total, round(avg(double3) - avg(double2), 1) AS unsupported, if(avg(double3) > 0, round(avg(double2) / avg(double3), 2), 1.0) AS support_ratio FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'card_report' GROUP BY oracle_id, name ORDER BY unsupported DESC, reports DESC LIMIT 50

spec.description: Player 'report this card' clicks grouped by oracle_id + name. Default-sorted by 'unsupported' (avg_total - avg_supported) so the biggest parser gaps lead. 'support_ratio' is avg_supported / avg_total (1.0 = fully parsed). High unsupported / low ratio = the parser is missing clauses the card claims; unsupported = 0 (support_ratio 1.0) points at a runtime/engine bug on an already-parsed card — click those column headers to re-sort into either triage queue.
spec.title: Top reported cards

spec.query: SELECT blob5 AS route, sum(_sample_interval) AS views FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'route_view' GROUP BY route ORDER BY views DESC

spec.description: route_view counts per coarse route (ids/params stripped). Shares the route vocabulary of js_error.route and session_start.route.
spec.title: Route usage

spec.query: SELECT blob9 AS abandons, blob7 AS game_mode, sum(_sample_interval) AS games, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, argMax(blob2, timestamp) AS latest_version FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'game_end' AND blob9 != '' GROUP BY abandons, game_mode ORDER BY games DESC LIMIT 30

spec.description: game_end events that abandoned pending triggers, grouped by the abandoned set.
spec.title: Pending-trigger abandons (grouped)

spec.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, if(blob6 = '', '(unknown)', blob6) AS format, sum(_sample_interval) AS games FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'game_start' GROUP BY t, format ORDER BY t

spec.description: Stacked daily game starts by engine GameFormat; (unknown) = clients predating the format field (2026-07).
spec.title: Games started per day (by format)

spec.query: SELECT if(blob6 = '', '(unknown)', blob6) AS format, blob5 AS game_mode, sum(_sample_interval) AS games, round(avg(double1), 1) AS avg_players, round(avg(double2), 1) AS avg_ai FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'game_start' GROUP BY format, game_mode ORDER BY games DESC

spec.description: Game starts per format and mode, with average seat and AI counts.
spec.title: Games by format x mode

spec.query: SELECT sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'session_start'

spec.description: session_start events in range — the denominator for the session rates.
spec.title: Sessions

spec.query: SELECT blob2 AS version, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start') AS sessions, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') AS games, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'engine_panic') AS panics, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'js_error') AS js_errors, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'stuck_decision') AS stuck, if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'engine_panic') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'game_start'), 2), 0) AS panics_per_100_games, if(sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start') > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'js_error') / sumIf(_sample_interval, blob1 = 'session_start'), 2), 0) AS js_errors_per_100_sessions, min(timestamp) AS first_seen FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 IN ('session_start', 'game_start', 'engine_panic', 'js_error', 'stuck_decision') GROUP BY version ORDER BY first_seen DESC LIMIT 15

spec.description: Per app_version usage and failure rates, newest version first.
spec.title: Health by version

spec.query: SELECT blob5 AS waiting_for, blob7 AS phase, blob6 AS game_mode, sum(_sample_interval) AS occurrences, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, argMax(blob2, timestamp) AS latest_version FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'stuck_decision' GROUP BY waiting_for, phase, game_mode ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 30

spec.description: Which engine prompts wedge, grouped by WaitingFor kind and phase.
spec.title: Stuck decisions (by WaitingFor)

spec.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob2 AS version, sum(_sample_interval) AS sessions FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'session_start' GROUP BY t, version ORDER BY t

spec.description: session_start per day by app_version — how fast players pick up a release.
spec.title: Version adoption (sessions per day)

spec.query: SELECT $timeSeries AS t, blob5 AS reason, sum(_sample_interval) AS disconnects FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'p2p_disconnect' GROUP BY t, reason ORDER BY t

spec.description: p2p_disconnect per day by DisconnectCause.
spec.title: P2P disconnects per day (by reason)

spec.query: SELECT blob5 AS reason, blob7 AS ice_state, blob8 AS visibility, sum(_sample_interval) AS disconnects, round(avg(double1)) AS avg_pong_age_ms FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'p2p_disconnect' GROUP BY reason, ice_state, visibility ORDER BY disconnects DESC LIMIT 30

spec.description: Disconnect cause x ICE state x tab visibility; a hidden tab or failed ICE points at different fixes.
spec.title: P2P disconnect context

spec.query: SELECT blob5 AS server, blob6 AS outcome, sum(_sample_interval) AS probes, round(avgIf(double1, double1 > 0)) AS avg_rtt_ms, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'server_probe' GROUP BY server, outcome ORDER BY server, probes DESC

spec.description: Server-directory probe outcomes per server; avg_rtt_ms ignores probes with no latency.
spec.title: Community server probes

spec.query: SELECT if(blob1 = 'game_start', 'native_fallback', blob1) AS event, if(blob1 = 'game_start', blob8, blob5) AS detail, blob4 AS platform, sum(_sample_interval) AS occurrences, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, argMax(blob2, timestamp) AS latest_version FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND (blob1 IN ('chunk_reload', 'wasm_not_initialized') OR (blob1 = 'game_start' AND blob8 != '')) GROUP BY event, detail, platform ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 30

spec.description: chunk_reload (detail = reason), wasm_not_initialized (detail = operation), and native_fallback (game_start whose native engine fell back; detail = fallback reason).
spec.title: Load & engine-init failures

spec.query: SELECT blob7 AS game_mode, sum(_sample_interval) AS games, sumIf(_sample_interval, blob8 != '') AS with_unimplemented, if(sum(_sample_interval) > 0, round(100 * sumIf(_sample_interval, blob8 != '') / sum(_sample_interval), 1), 0) AS pct FROM ${dataset} WHERE $timeFilter AND blob1 = 'game_end' GROUP BY game_mode ORDER BY games DESC

spec.description: Share of finished games that contained at least one unimplemented card.
spec.title: Unimplemented-card exposure (by mode)

spec.name: dataset
spec.label: Channel
spec.description: Analytics Engine dataset: production (phase-rs.dev) or preview (preview.phase-rs.dev)
spec.query: Production : phase_telemetry,Preview : phase_telemetry_preview
